test_title: PYST 49: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All plants are vegetables.

Some plants are poisonous.

**Conclusions:**

I. All vegetables are poisonous.

II. Some vegetables are plants.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible venn diagram is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83d78f19b536f5aad6158cb136cc19c498004e1d8eca0ee5ac2b880e44d743db.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All vegetables are poisonous → **Not Follows** (Because all plants are vegetables, and some plants are poisonous).

II. Some vegetables are plants → **Follows **(Because all plants are vegetables).

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Only conclusion II follows".**
